social_circle.name: Laura Dodd

demographics.occupation: administrative office worker and primary family scheduler
demographics.education: high school graduate with some postsecondary coursework

background.how_they_met: Laura is Randy's mother and has cared for him since birth.
background.why_close: She is Randy's first comfort person, manages his school routine, health care, bedtime reading, and daily needs.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short, clear full sentences with practical reminders, heart emojis, and photos; Randy's replies are usually dictated, emoji-heavy, or short voice-to-text messages on a parent's phone.

recent_text_topics: Reminders about backpack, shoes, school folder, and bedtime routine.
Photos or notes about Randy reading new words at night and drawing dinosaurs.
Reassurance about thunder, shots, and kindergarten worries, often with simple comfort messages.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Mama packs Randy's lunch and reads books with him at night; Q49 says Mama is the first person he goes to for comfort; Q40 and Q42 show Mama manages appointments and explains health things.

social_circle.name: Daniel Dodd

demographics.education: high school graduate with trade experience

background.how_they_met: Daniel is Randy's father and has lived with him throughout Randy's childhood.
background.why_close: They bond over tools, toy parts, LEGO building, and Randy's curiosity about how things work.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief and practical texts, often with photos of tools, trucks, or repaired items; Randy sends excited short replies, voice notes, and pictures of builds.

shared_activities: helping with practical repairs around home
recent_text_topics: Pictures of LEGO bridges, garages, and fire stations Randy built.
Questions about toy wheels, screws, and where small parts belong.
Saturday soccer updates and reminders to keep trying after missed kicks.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 says Daddy helped Randy open a broken toy car with a tiny screwdriver; Q05 says they build LEGOs and look at toy parts; Q49 says Daddy helps with toy problems.

social_circle.name: Betty Dodd

background.how_they_met: Betty is Randy's grandmother on the Dodd side; the interview identifies Grandma as a frequent visitor and support figure, though her first name is inferred.
background.why_close: She visits, sometimes gives Randy coins for his piggy bank, and is one of the people he tells exciting news to after Mama.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm, informal texts with pet names like 'Randy-boy,' lots of check-ins, and occasional emoji; Randy replies with dictated updates, stickers, or photos.

recent_text_topics: Randy's new reading progress and school stories.
Coins for his piggy bank and whether he is saving for a LEGO set or toy fire truck.
Plans for Sunday visits, cousins coming over, and family meals.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says grandparents call him 'Randy-boy'; Q06 says Grandma comes sometimes and Randy tells Mama first, then sometimes Grandma, when excited; Q61 says Grandma sometimes gives him coins.

social_circle.name: Mason Parker

background.how_they_met: Mason met Randy in kindergarten at their local public school.
background.why_close: They both like trucks, blocks, racing, and recess play, making Mason Randy's named peer friend.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Parent-mediated kid messages: short dictated lines, silly photos, truck emojis, and occasional voice clips rather than independent texting.

shared_activities: arguing and making up over crayons or toys
recent_text_topics: Asking if the other will be at school or soccer-related play dates.
Sharing pictures of toy trucks, block towers, or dirt roads made at recess.
Running jokes about who gets the red crayon or whose truck is fastest.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names Mason: Randy likes playing with Mason at school because Mason likes trucks too; Q07 also says friends play tag, build block towers, race, climb, and dig roads in the dirt.

social_circle.name: Eli Johnson

background.how_they_met: Eli is inferred as one of Randy's nearby cousins who visits on weekends, after church, crawfish boils, and birthdays; the cousin role is documented but the name is inferred.
background.why_close: They see each other often through family gatherings and share outdoor play, racing, hide-and-seek, and food-centered family events.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Family-phone texting with short kid phrases, funny photos, and parent relays; sometimes sends voice notes asking when Randy can come outside.

recent_text_topics: Whether cousins are coming over after church or on the weekend.
Planning races, hide-and-seek, and porch-to-tree challenges.
Family food days, birthdays, and whether Randy will bring LEGOs or toy cars.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Randy plays with cousins at crawfish boils and birthdays, including chase, hide-and-seek, and racing from the porch to the tree; Q06 says cousins come on weekends or after church; Q13 says cousins visit for family food days.
